news.title: Max Miller, Republican Accused of Abuse, Won’t Drop Out, Spokeswoman Says
news.summary: Mr. Miller, who has faced pressure from fellow Republicans to end his campaign and avoid endangering a solidly red seat in Ohio, will stay in the race, his spokeswoman said.
